bio: Discover Sabine Rooftop Bar in St. Paul's, where sky-high views meet culinary innovation. Elevate your afternoon with this new Bottomless Garden Afternoon Tea, a contemporary twist on the English classic. Indulge in endless bubbles alongside tasty bites all against the backdrop of London's iconic skyline.  The brand-new Afternoon Tea menu is inspired by the classic English Garden but based in the clouds of the London's Skyline.  The secret garden is an oasis from The City, allowing guests to transport to a hidden space away from the busy London streets, where you can enjoy beautiful views of St Paul’s. With an outside terrace and a glass roof, Sabine Rooftop bar is the place to be for a great night out.  Sabine Rooftop Bar is situation around St Pauls.
